4. Tool Details
Tool Name: Text-to-Excel Generator
Primary Function: Converts raw text content into structured Excel spreadsheets dynamically.
Core Processing Engine: Uses Pandas DataFrame Transformation and OpenPyXL Excel generation.
Dynamic Header Detection: Automatically identifies delimiters such as pipe (|) and comma (
JSON Parsing Capability: Supports valid and malformed JSON structure recovery using heuristic repair logic.
Fallback Extraction Logic: Uses regex-based key-value extraction when standard JSON parsing fails.
Multi-line Record Handling: Merges broken or wrapped text lines into the correct data rows.
Schema Matrix Normalization: Dynamically aligns parent-child row structures into tabular format.
GitHub Integration: Uploads generated Excel files directly into a specified GitHub repository using GitHub REST API.
Authentication Method: Uses GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) for secure repository access.
Supported Output Format: Microsoft Excel (.xlsx).
Error Handling: Detects empty content
Libraries Used: Pandas
Logging Utility: Captures execution logs and error details
